scripts.api:check: npm run api:generate && git diff --exit-code -- src/api/generated/schema.ts
scripts.i18n:check: npm run i18n:generate && git diff --exit-code -- src/generated/i18n/catalogs.ts
scripts.routes:check: npm run routes:generate && git diff --exit-code -- src/app/routes.ts
scripts.verify: npm run api:check && npm run i18n:check && npm run routes:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.check: npm run verify && npm run build
